chung.Syllabus Name: Management and Marketing_Nhập môn Quản trị và Marketing
chung.Time Allocation: 150 hours = 45 contact hours, 1hour final exam, 104 hours of self-study
chung.Description:
The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of both classical and contemporary marketing theories, as well as their practical applications. Throughout the course, students will engage with new classical and contemporary cases, exploring the interdisciplinary and cross-functional implications of business management theories, contemporary marketing management principles, and futuristic applications of marketing management theories and concepts. The course also highlights the evolving role of emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), in shaping modern marketing practices.

Upon completion, students will be able to:

1. Understand the significance of management and marketing across organisational contexts.

2. Explain the fundamental principles governing management and marketing.

3. Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills for business and marketing challenges.

4. Apply and critically evaluate AI tools responsibly for market data collection, consumer behaviour analysis, and marketing strategy development, while considering accuracy, bias, and ethical implications
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours to be eligible for the final examination.

- Complete and submit all assigned exercises, questions, and assignments on time.

- Use laptops in class solely for course-related activities.

- Regularly access the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for updated course information.

- For each assignment involving AI tools, students must explicitly distinguish between AI-generated content and their own analysis, ensuring academic integrity (Submit AI Appendix with all assignments, including prompts, screenshots, and reflections on AI usage)
chung.Tools: Computer, textbook, Coursera, approved AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, and other tools), and the university site system

danhGia: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

Group Project.Suggested topic: Conduct a comprehensive market research project for a selected product/service. The project will progress through clearly defined phases, including problem definition, research design, data collection, data analysis, and presentation of findings. The study should employ both primary and secondary data sources, with evidence of the research process (e.g., survey results, interview transcripts, observation notes) submitted alongside the final report. Students are encouraged to leverage AI tools to support market research activities (such as data analysis, customer insight generation, and content creation for marketing strategies), provided that the use of AI is transparent and critically evaluated. Recommendations for the company’s marketing strategies must be grounded in theoretical frameworks and models covered in the course.

- Assess the knowledge students have acquired in class up to the time of the assignment.- Utilize AI tools to support market research, product ideation, and editing of campaign outputs, as permitted by the course guidelines.

Group Project – Marketing Plan/Proposal (100%)

(a) Company Introduction (Vision, Mission, Core values, Business Portfolio) (5% of Total Grade, Max: 0.5 points)

(b) Organizational structure (5% of Total Grade, Max: 0.5 points)

(c) Market Research & Situation Analysis (20% of Total Grade, Max: 2 points)

(d) Segmentation, Targeting, and Positioning (STP) (20% of Total Grade, Max: 2.0 points)

(e) Marketing Mix (4Ps) Strategy (20% of Total Grade, Max: 2 points)

(f) Use of AI and Innovation (15% of Total Grade, Max: 1.5 points)

(g) Presentation & Q&A (15% of Total Grade, Max: 1.5 points)

AI Appendix Submission (mandatory): All assignments that involve AI must include an AI log (prompts + reflection). This is not graded separately but is required as part of the completion criteria.
According to the predetermined LOs, lecturers have the flexibility to choose assignment forms.

Individual AssignmentSuggested topic: Analyse customer behavior for a selected company (B2B or B2C). Students will collect primary data through observation, mini-surveys, or interviews, and design the Buyer Decision Process (5 steps). From these findings, they will develop a Customer Journey Map that highlights key decision points and potential touchpoints. AI tools may be used to support data analysis and persona generation, but students must demonstrate their own reasoning in integrating insights and proposing optimization strategies.
- Assess the knowledge students have acquired in class up to the time of the assignment.- Utilize AI tools to support market research
